# Topology.MoveAPI.movable

Exports: `Topology.MoveAPI.movable`, `Topology.movable`

## `movable(d::KnotGaussDiagram, type, arg::NamedTuple) -> Vector{ReidemeisterCandidate}`

    movable(d::KnotGaussDiagram, type, arg::NamedTuple) -> Vector{ReidemeisterCandidate}

Return local Reidemeister witnesses using a named selector record.

# Arguments
K1 and K13 and the alias precedence in
[move selectors](../../specs/knot-gauss.md#move-selectors) apply.
The extracted selections have exactly the domain of the keyword overload;
its `ArgumentError`, conversion and malformed-pair failures propagate.
Unrecognized record fields are ignored, and `strict` has no effect.

# Returns
The keyword overload's vector of `ReidemeisterCandidate` records, with
source binding and local data as defined by the [witness specification](../../specs/knot-gauss.md#enumeration-and-move-witnesses).

# Guarantees
1. The result equals the keyword query selected by the record's recognized fields. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The diagram and record are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
This is not a validation of all fields in an arbitrary record. It adds no
classicality or topological guarantee beyond the keyword query.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/knot-gauss.md, Move selectors — compatibility record and positional selector meaning.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> d = KnotGaussDiagram([1,-1], [1]);

julia> length(movable(d, "R1", (p=:delete, v=[1], e=[(1,2)])))
1
```

Role: access

## `movable(d::KnotGaussDiagram, type; param=nothing, vertices=Int[], edges=nothing, strict=false) -> Vector{ReidemeisterCandidate}`

    movable(d::KnotGaussDiagram, type; param=nothing, vertices=Int[], edges=nothing, strict=false) -> Vector{ReidemeisterCandidate}

Return the source-bound local Reidemeister witnesses matching the selected knot data.

# Arguments
`d` satisfies K1; the selector domain and coordinate meanings are K13 and
[move selectors](../../specs/knot-gauss.md#move-selectors).
Unknown move families and unsupported direction parameters raise
`ArgumentError` naming the invalid family or parameter. Selector entries
convert to `Int`; malformed edge pairs can raise `DimensionMismatch`.
A well-formed selector with no matching witness returns an empty vector.
The compatibility keyword `strict` is accepted but has no effect.
Classicality K2 is not checked.

# Returns
A `Vector{ReidemeisterCandidate}`. Its elements carry the source, local
replacement and selected positions with the
[witness meaning](../../specs/knot-gauss.md#enumeration-and-move-witnesses).
Distinct cyclic locations can give distinct witnesses for the same target.

# Guarantees
1. Each result is a local R1, R2 or R3 candidate bound to `d` and matching the supplied selectors in their specified order. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The output is the finite candidate population for the supported local rules and selectors; omitting a selector imposes no restriction of that kind. [proved/agent: by construction]
3. The diagram and selectors are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
Witnesses are not deduplicated by target knot or canonical representation.
No planar-realizability test or knot classification is performed. The general
identification of every local rule with the cited literature convention
remains unverified as recorded in the specification; apply and verify a
selected transition before retaining it as evidence.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/knot-gauss.md, Enumeration and move witnesses, Move selectors — supported local witness population and source-comparison boundary.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> d = KnotGaussDiagram(Int[], Int[]);

julia> length(movable(d, "R1"; param=:insert))
4
```

See also [`apply_reidemeister`](../knot/apply_reidemeister.md), [`verify_reidemeister_transition`](../knot/verify_reidemeister_transition.md).

Role: access

## `movable(input::HeegaardCode, row; kwargs...) -> Vector{Topology.HeegaardCodes.LCMoveWitness}`

    movable(input::HeegaardCode, row; kwargs...) -> Vector{Topology.HeegaardCodes.LCMoveWitness}

Enumerate supported Heegaard move witnesses through the common presentation interface.

# Arguments
`input` satisfies the [Heegaard move domain](../../specs/heegaard-moves.md).
`row` is a catalog dictionary or its string identifier; row-dependent
selection keywords have the domain of `Topology.HeegaardCodes.movable`.
Unknown identifiers raise `LCMoveError` naming the catalog failure. Input,
mark-transport, support and missing-selection errors propagate from the
selected query. Arbitrary dictionaries are not certified catalog rows.
The one-argument overload also accepts `LickorishCode` and selects its default
finite witness pool. Named-row LC queries use `Topology.HeegaardCodes.movable`.
Knot and VirtualLink methods have their separate contracts and selectors.

# Returns
A vector of the [LC move witness records](../../specs/heegaard-moves.md#comparison-and-move-witnesses)
returned by the corresponding Heegaard interface. Each record refers to its
source presentation, selected support and catalog relation.

# Guarantees
1. A named-row HC query has the same result as `Topology.HeegaardCodes.movable(input,row;kwargs...)`. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The one-argument LC/HC query returns that interface's default finite pool; it omits the inverse-stabilization row and suppresses row-level `LCMoveError` failures. [proved/agent: by construction]
3. The input presentation is not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
A returned relation tag does not itself prove preservation of a represented
manifold. The default pool does not enumerate arbitrary twist powers or all
geometric supports. Empty output establishes only absence from the selected
implemented search range. A one-argument query is not provided for every
registered presentation type.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/module-structure.md §3.1 — common move interface.
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/heegaard-moves.md §§4 and 6 — witness meaning and finite selection ranges.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> H = Topology.HeegaardCodes; lc = H.LickorishCode(1, Dict("l1" => [-1], "m1" => [1]), Dict(), Dict(), Dict(), Dict(), nothing); hc = H.resolve_hc(lc, Dict("l1" => :beta); standard=true);

julia> length(movable(hc, "lc.twist.annulus"))
4
```

## `movable(v::VirtualLink, type, arg::NamedTuple) -> Vector{MoveCandidate}`

    movable(v::VirtualLink, type, arg::NamedTuple) -> Vector{MoveCandidate}

Return VirtualLink move candidates selected by a named argument record.

# Arguments
The [named selector aliases](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#41-namedtuple-argument-aliases)
and the keyword overload's source, placement and weight requirements apply.
Conflicting aliases in one record are not diagnosed as an error.
`edge_occurrences` and `boundary` are also forwarded when present.
Unrecognized fields are ignored. All failures of the selected keyword query
propagate; this overload does not validate an arbitrary argument schema.

# Returns
The same vector of [MoveCandidate records](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#61-movecandidate)
as the corresponding keyword selection.

# Guarantees
1. Results have the local matching and weight-mode guarantees of the keyword overload. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The source's words, crossing data and weights and the supplied record are unchanged. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
This adds no global topological certification or search completeness to the
keyword overload. Unrecognized record fields are not reported as errors.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/virtual-link-moves.md §§4 and 6 — record selectors and candidate meaning.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> v = VirtualLink(); set_data!(v; rgauss=[[-1,2,-2,3,-3,1,0]], orientation=[1,1,1]);

julia> length(movable(v, "MP", (p="C3", v=[1,2], strict=true)))
1
```

## `movable(v::VirtualLink, type; boundary=nothing, param=nothing, vertices=Int[], edges=nothing, edge_occurrences=nothing, strict=false) -> Vector{MoveCandidate}`

    movable(v::VirtualLink, type; boundary=nothing, param=nothing, vertices=Int[], edges=nothing, edge_occurrences=nothing, strict=false) -> Vector{MoveCandidate}

Return supported local move candidates for a VirtualLink in its current weight mode.

# Arguments
Use the presentation domain in [VirtualLink data](../../specs/virtual-link-data-model.md),
the [vertex and edge selections](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#6-candidate-contract),
[direction choices](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#7-direction-selection),
and [insertion occurrences](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#15-current-support-matrix).
The caller supplies coherent source data. This is not a global validity check.
Move names, parameter case and `strict` follow [§4](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#4-public-api).
Missing or incompatible selections raise `ArgumentError` naming the move or
selection; malformed pairs can raise `DimensionMismatch`, and conversion,
indexing and unsupported-keyword failures propagate. No matching placement
returns an empty vector. An omitted vertex list does not mean every subset.
Integer weights must satisfy the applicable [§12 requirements](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#12-weight-transport).
In Z2 mode, spin data and optional cut-boundary targets have the domain of
`spin_cp_move`; a boundary target on a closed CP source raises `ArgumentError`.

# Returns
A `Vector{MoveCandidate}` with the selected local data described by the
[candidate record](../../specs/virtual-link-moves.md#61-movecandidate).
Use `move(v,candidate)` to obtain a result for inspection.

# Guarantees
1. Returned candidates satisfy the selected supported local matching rules; PS candidates additionally pass `validate_ps_move`. This is evidence about local presentation data. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. In integer-weighted mode only MP, H, 02 and PS are offered, and returned candidates pass the current application checks. In Z2 mode only CP is offered, with successful spin transport checks. Other families in those modes return an empty vector. [proved/agent: by construction]
3. R1, R2 and R3 queries on this representation return an empty vector; their knot representation has a separate method. [proved/agent: by construction]
4. The source's words, crossing data and weights are unchanged. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
A candidate is not a theorem of manifold, combing or framing preservation.
Unweighted local matching alone does not guarantee successful full application
or an inverse witness. Empty output can mean unsupported weight mode/family,
not mathematical impossibility. Candidate order and multiplicity do not
provide a canonical choice. Boundary targets are interpreted only by the
applicable transport route; they are not a generic boundary validator.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/virtual-link-moves.md §§6–8, 12 and 15 — supported candidates and coefficient-dependent domain.
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/spin-weights.md — algebraic meaning and geometric boundary of spin targets.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> v = VirtualLink(); set_data!(v; rgauss=[[-1,2,-2,3,-3,1,0]], orientation=[1,1,1]);

julia> length(movable(v, "MP"; param="C3", vertices=[1,2], strict=true))
1
```
